saints.name: Sts. Martha, Mary, and Lazarus
saints.title: Friends of the Lord
saints.shortBlurb: The household of Bethany whom Jesus loved and where he found welcome and rest…
biography: At Bethany near Jerusalem lived the sisters Martha and Mary and their brother Lazarus, in whose home Jesus was a frequent and beloved guest. Martha served attentively and made the great confession of faith at her brother's tomb; Mary sat at the Lord's feet to hear his word and anointed him at Bethany; and Lazarus was raised by Christ after four days in the grave.

The Gospel says simply that “Jesus loved Martha and her sister and Lazarus,” and their home is a model of Christian hospitality and friendship with the Lord. Pope Francis in 2021 broadened the memorial, once kept of St. Martha alone, to honor all three together.
saints.knownFor: Their friendship with Jesus and hospitality at Bethany.
